title: Remove/Recover a specific AGV by robot ID using OptiSweep→Geek API requests
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API client to send a Geek request to remove a specified AGV from the system (RemoveAgv) or re-add it (RecoverAGV). Both API actions require the target robot ID.
when_to_use: When you need to remove a specific AGV from the system roster (RemoveAgv) or re-add it (RecoverAGV) by sending the correct OptiSweep→Geek API request using the required robot ID.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for identifying the correct robot ID; if the robot ID is incorrect/missing, the request cannot target the intended AGV.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the OptiSweep / WCS API client requests (RemoveAgv / RecoverAGV) using the correct robot ID and verify the API client response indicates acceptance/success.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog / WCS API client (or equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client surface)

system_preconditions: You have the target AGV's robot ID to use in the API request.

visual_references.description: API action definitions: RemoveAgv requires robot ID and sends a request to Geek to remove the specified AGV; RecoverAGV requires robot ID and sends a request to Geek to add the specified AGV.

steps.title: Identify the target AGV robot ID for the API request
steps.purpose: The RemoveAgv/RecoverAGV requests require the robot ID to target the correct AGV.
steps.instruction: Obtain the target AGV's robot ID that you will enter into the OptiSweep / WCS API request.
steps.expected_result: You have a specific robot ID value ready to use for the RemoveAgv and RecoverAGV requests.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot ID you plan to use corresponds to the intended AGV you are trying to remove/recover.
steps.failure_condition: The robot ID is incorrect or missing.

actions.label: Confirm robot ID
actions.exact_action: Identify the target AGV's robot ID that will be used for the API request.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot ID is incorrect or missing, do not submit RemoveAgv/RecoverAGV; confirm the robot ID before retrying.

steps.purpose: Ensure you are using the correct API action (RemoveAgv) and that it is configured to remove the specified AGV using the robot ID.
